invariants.rationale: The method checks the value of operationType, so it should not be null.
instantTime is passed to downstream methods, so it should be non-null.
table is used to call methods, so it must be non-null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used to check containsInstant, so it must be non-null.
The method immediately throws if operationType is LOG_COMPACT, so at entry this is not necessarily true, but is guarded at the start of the method.
